episode_title: 《楚氏春秋》第2集：空难魂穿·转世重生
canon_chapter: chapter_003_第二章_转世重生.md + chapter_004_第三章_颠倒乾坤.md

shots.scene_summary: Inside a violently shaking modern passenger airliner cabin at night with red emergency lights glowing and yellow oxygen masks hanging down, flight attendant <Subject 1> on the left grips a seat back and urgently broadcasts an emergency water ditching warning into the intercom handset, while 28-year-old modern man <Subject 2> belted in his window seat on the right stares desperately at his glowing smartphone and sends a final farewell text message to his wife before the crash.
shots.camera_motion: tense cinematic medium two-shot inside the shaking airliner cabin with a dramatic push-in
shots.soundscape: Low rumbling aircraft engine vibration, cabin warning chimes, and stormy wind outside the cabin window accompany the urgent foreground Mandarin dialogue.

dialogue_1.action: on the left grips the seat back tightly under flashing red cabin lights and speaks urgently into the cabin intercom handset
dialogue_1.line: 机舱遭遇强烈气流正在紧急迫降，请全体乘客系紧安全带，穿好救生衣！

dialogue_2.action: on the right grips his glowing smartphone with trembling hands, his eyes filled with tears and desperation as he speaks in a choked, heartbroken young man voice
dialogue_2.line: 老婆，电话怎么打不通……最后这条短信，我爱你，永别了！

shots.scene_summary: Inside the sunlit classical carved wooden bedroom of the Chu Mansion in the Great Zhao Dynasty, 6-year-old <Subject 1> (Chu Zheng, with a white bandage around his forehead) sits upright on the silk bed on the left, staring at his tiny 6-year-old hands in utter shock after his modern soul awakens in this child's body, while Mother <Subject 2> (Wang Xiuhe) on the right leans forward beside the bed with tears of relief and reaches out lovingly toward him.
shots.camera_motion: smooth dramatic medium two-shot by the carved wooden canopy bed with a gentle slow push-in
shots.soundscape: Quiet classical bedroom ambience and rustling silk bedding accompany the clear foreground Mandarin dialogue.

dialogue_1.action: sitting upright on the bed on the left stares down at his own tiny hands with wide, bewildered eyes and speaks in a startled, disbelieving 6-year-old boy voice
dialogue_1.line: 这……这是哪里？飞机不是坠海了吗？我的手怎么变成六岁小孩子了？！

dialogue_2.action: on the right leans forward beside the bed with tearful relief and gentle maternal warmth, reaching out her hands as she speaks in a loving, anxious mother's voice
dialogue_2.line: 小五儿，你终于醒了！我是娘亲啊，你怎么连娘都不认得了？

shots.scene_summary: Inside the candlelit Chu Mansion bedroom at night, Mother <Subject 1> (Wang Xiuhe, with a red bruised scrape on her forehead after kowtowing to pray for her son) on the left holds 6-year-old <Subject 2> (Chu Zheng) tightly in her arms with tears streaming down her face and vows to care for him forever even if he becomes foolish, while <Subject 2> on the right gently touches his mother's cheek with tears in his eyes as his two souls merge in deep filial gratitude.
shots.camera_motion: emotional close-medium two-shot in warm candlelight with a slow, intimate dolly-in
shots.soundscape: Soft night candle crackle and gentle silk sleeve movement accompany the deeply emotional foreground Mandarin dialogue.

dialogue_1.action: on the left with a bruised forehead embraces her young son tightly with tears glistening on her cheeks, speaking in a trembling, unconditionally loving maternal voice
dialogue_1.line: 别怕孩子，有娘在！就算你以后变成疯子傻子，娘也照料你一辈子！

dialogue_2.action: in his mother's warm embrace on the right raises his small hand to touch her cheek, his dark eyes brimming with moved tears as he speaks softly and resolutely
dialogue_2.line: 娘……别哭了，从今往后我就是你的小五儿，我再也不让娘伤心了！

shots.scene_summary: Inside the classical side hall of the Chu Mansion, beside 6-year-old Chu Zheng who sits peacefully asleep on the left couch, Blood Shadow Sect Master <Subject 1> (Wu Anran, disguised as a scholar in a slate-gray robe) in the center-left withdraws his glowing palm from atop Chu Zheng's head in utter astonishment at discovering the boy's naturally connected Ren and Du meridians, while Prefect <Subject 2> (Chu Mingtang) on the right steps forward anxiously to ask about his son's condition.
shots.camera_motion: dramatic medium two-shot in the classical side hall with a slow push-in
shots.soundscape: Subtle low resonant qi hum fading into quiet hall ambience accompanies the clear foreground Mandarin dialogue.

dialogue_1.action: on the left gazes at the sleeping child in utter disbelief as he withdraws his palm, speaking in a shocked, magnetic baritone voice
dialogue_1.line: 十成大搜魂手真气入体，竟毫无阻滞？！原来世上真有天生任督二脉相通的奇才！

dialogue_2.action: on the right in his purple dragon-brocade official robe steps forward with clasped hands and asks in an anxious, dignified paternal baritone voice
dialogue_2.line: 吴先生，小儿的脉象究竟如何，这病可还有医治的眉目？

shots.scene_summary: In the sunlit courtyard of the Chu Mansion beside a stone table with a porcelain teapot, martial arts master <Subject 1> (Wu Anran) on the left raises his hand with a charismatic smile as a glowing emerald-green stream of tea water coils in mid-air like a small translucent water dragon and invites 6-year-old <Subject 2> (Chu Zheng) to learn martial arts, while <Subject 2> on the right watches with sparkling, excited eyes and eagerly agrees.
shots.camera_motion: cinematic medium two-shot in the sunlit courtyard with a smooth slow dolly-in
shots.soundscape: Crisp flowing water swirl sound and gentle courtyard breeze accompany the lively foreground Mandarin dialogue.

dialogue_1.action: on the left gestures gracefully with his fingers guiding the floating green tea-water dragon in mid-air, smiling charismatically as he speaks in a warm, enticing baritone voice
dialogue_1.line: 五公子你看好了，把这门功夫练成，天下就没人敢欺负你，要不要跟伯伯学？

dialogue_2.action: on the right gazes at the floating green water stream with wide, sparkling eyes and nods eagerly, speaking in an excited, determined 6-year-old boy voice
dialogue_2.line: 要学！只要能保护娘亲和咱们楚家，再苦的功夫小五儿都愿意学！
